# Load the packages

```{r setup, include =FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
devtools::load_all()

```

# Genome assembly visualization
## Load the data

```{r, eval=TRUE}

#Read wSuz genome
genome <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(here::here("data", "genomic_data", "wSuz_RW2025a.fasta"))

contig_lengths <- data.frame(Contig = sub(" .*", "", names(genome)), Length = Biostrings::width(genome))

#Read cif genes positions

blast_cif <- read.csv(here::here("data", "genomic_data", "BLAST_query.csv"))
names(blast_cif)
unique(blast_cif$Query)

#Add strand and coordinated for start and the end
cif <- blast_cif |> dplyr::mutate(Start = pmin(Subject_start, Subject_end), End = pmax(Subject_start, Subject_end), Strand = ifelse(Subject_start < Subject_end, "+", "-"))

#Remove not necessary information and add contig number
cif <- blast_cif |> dplyr::transmute(Query, Contig = Subject, Start = pmin(Subject_start, Subject_end), End = pmax(Subject_start, Subject_end), Strand = ifelse(Subject_start < Subject_end, "+", "-"))

#Add information about gene and type of the gene 
cif <- cif |> dplyr::mutate(Gene = dplyr::case_when(grepl("ISWpi7|ISWp7", Query) ~ "ISWpi7", grepl("_A", Query) ~ "cifA", grepl("_B", Query) ~ "cifB", TRUE ~ NA_character_), Type = dplyr::case_when(grepl("ISWpi7|ISWp7", Query) ~ "IS", grepl("TypeI_|Type1_", Query) ~ "Type I", grepl("TypeII_", Query) ~ "Type II", TRUE ~ NA_character_))

cif <- cif |> dplyr::arrange(Contig, Start)

## Add position of each contig on Y
contig_lengths$y <- rev(seq_len(nrow(contig_lengths)))
cif <- merge(cif, contig_lengths[, c("Contig", "y")], by = "Contig", all.x = TRUE)

```

## Create Figure 4A

```{r, eval=TRUE}

library(gggenomes)

#Rename column for the figure
contig_lengths <- contig_lengths |> dplyr::rename(seq_id = Contig, length = Length)
cif <- cif |> dplyr::rename(start = Start, end = End, seq_id = Contig)

cif <- cif |> dplyr::mutate(start2 = start, end2 = end, start = ifelse(Strand == "-", end2, start2), end = ifelse(Strand == "-", start2, end2)) |> dplyr::select(-start2, -end2)

#Combine cifA and cifB in one locus

typeI_loci <- cif |> dplyr::filter(Type == "Type I") |> dplyr::mutate(left = pmin(start, end), right = pmax(start, end)) |> dplyr::arrange(seq_id, left) |> dplyr::group_by(seq_id) |> dplyr::mutate(locus = cumsum(c(TRUE, left[-1] - right[-dplyr::n()] > 10000))) |> dplyr::group_by(seq_id, locus) |> dplyr::summarise(start = min(left), end = max(right), y = dplyr::first(y), Gene = paste(Gene, collapse = "-"), Strand = dplyr::first(Strand), .groups = "drop") |> dplyr::mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2, Name = "cifA–cifB", Type = "Type I", Query = "cifAB_TypeI")

typeII_locus <- cif |> dplyr::filter(Type == "Type II") |> dplyr::mutate(len = abs(end - start) + 1) |> dplyr::filter(Gene == "cifB" | (Gene == "cifA" & len > 1000)) |> dplyr::summarise(seq_id = dplyr::first(seq_id), start = min(pmin(start, end)), end = max(pmax(start, end)), y = dplyr::first(y), Gene = paste(Gene, collapse = "-"), Strand = dplyr::first(Strand)) |> dplyr::mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2, Name = "cifA3′–cifB", Type = "Type II", Query = "cifAB_TypeII")

cif_loci <- dplyr::bind_rows(typeI_loci, typeII_locus, cif |> dplyr::filter(Type == "Type II", Gene == "cifA", abs(end - start) + 1 < 1000) |> dplyr::mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2, Name = "cifA 5'"))

#Add labels for genes
cif <- cif |> dplyr::mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2)


cifA_plot <- cif_loci |> dplyr::filter(Name == "cifA Type II") |> dplyr::mutate(start = mid - 2500, end = mid + 2500)

cif_loci_plot <- cif_loci |> dplyr::mutate(start = ifelse(Strand == "+", mid - 7000, mid + 7000), end = ifelse(Strand == "+", mid + 7000, mid - 7000))

p <- gggenomes(seqs = contig_lengths, genes = cif_loci_plot) + geom_seq(linewidth = 1) + geom_gene(aes(fill = Type), colour = NA, size = 10) + geom_gene_tag(aes(label = Name, colour = Type), nudge_y = 0.2, angle = 30, size = 4, fontface = "italic") + geom_text(data = contig_lengths, aes(x = 0, y = y, label = seq_id), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, nudge_x = -20000, size = 4, fontface = "italic") + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.9, 4.5), clip = "off") + scale_fill_manual(values = c("Type I" = "#E83E8C", "Type II" = "#E89C50")) + scale_colour_manual(values = c("Type I" = "#FF339C", "Type II" = "#E89C50"), guide = "none") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 800000, 100000), labels = function(x) x / 1000, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) + coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + labs(x = "Position (kb)", fill = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12), legend.text = element_text(size = 12), legend.position = c(0.90, 0.50), plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 40))

p

title_plot <- "Fig.4A_wSuz_genome.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot), p, base_height = 10/cm(1), base_width = 14/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

```
